name: Click Frames GD
description: Practice recording, verified timing windows and replay showcases at 240 TPS.

air-rejoin.name: Audited airborne reconvergence
air-rejoin.description: Local scope can stop after three exact matching airborne ticks with matching RNG/causal/physical evidence and no active dynamic world effects. One in ten early passes is audited from zero to completion; a mismatch clears local windows and disables shortcuts. Does not claim universal hidden-state equality.

wide-window-cap.name: Broad window lower-bound cap
wide-window-cap.description: 0 measures to the configured radius. A positive value uses at least 8 valid ticks, displaying N+ and marking precision conservative. Never skips a hole or labels an open boundary exact.

checkpoint-budget.name: Event checkpoint targets
checkpoint-budget.description: Targets checkpoints just before clicks on the final reference run. Samples across the level if there are more targets than this. Object-state memory limits and fallback validation still apply.

scan-budget-ms.name: Analysis work budget per frame (ms)
scan-budget-ms.description: Up to 1024 recorded scheduler slices within this time budget. Confirmations may batch after reference parity succeeds; fallback keeps normal cadence.

precision-enabled.name: Statistical precision counter
precision-enabled.description: Computes the Frame Window Counter L* model from measured windows in a background worker. Sigma milliseconds are 1000/L*: a model estimate of timing dispersion, not device latency or click interval. Edited values are labeled.

flight-recovery.name: Probe neighboring flight inputs
flight-recovery.description: After a failed flight boundary, tries the next input at -1/+1 tick from a full restart. Saves alternative-route evidence in flight-recoveries.tsv without expanding fixed-macro windows.

batch-analysis.name: Batched analysis
batch-analysis.description: Replays recorded scheduler slices in bounded batches without drawing the hidden level between slices. Three reference runs check physical/causal parity. Budget is configurable; disable for mod conflicts. No time guarantee.

local-analysis.name: Fast local segment analysis
local-analysis.description: Tests until the reference landing or the next relevant action's exit zone. Does not certify later consequences in the full run. Turn off for full-route margins. Changing scope restarts measurements when Analyze is pressed.

same-jump.name: Validate landing in full-run mode
same-jump.description: In full-run mode, cube/robot jumps must also match the reference landing corridor. Local mode always checks its own reference exit.

native-states.name: Validated native state cache
native-states.description: Captures event-directed checkpoints with dynamic-map/object-count limits, validates continuation physics and tries earlier states on mismatch. Not a universal state snapshot or private mod state capture.

trajectory-preview.name: Analyzed trajectory preview
trajectory-preview.description: Show bounded traces from simulated candidates near their click during Play. Not live prediction for arbitrary manual inputs.

scan-speed.name: Analysis speed
scan-speed.description: Game speed while Verify/Analyze run behind a cover. 1.0 = normal. Lower it if your phone stutters.

max-rows.name: Max counter rows
max-rows.description: The counter shows every width from the smallest to the largest measured window, including empty widths. If there are more than this, the widest ones share one row (for example 8+).
